caption: The drawing depicts a Victorian-style sofa with an ornate wooden frame. The sofa features three distinct backrest sections; the two on either end are taller and oval-shaped, while the center section is wider and slightly lower. All three sections are upholstered in a deep pink or reddish fabric, accented with button-tufted details. The frame of the sofa is dark brown wood, carved with intricate scrollwork and floral patterns along the top, arms, and legs. The seat cushion is also covered in the same pink or reddish fabric as the backrests. The armrests are partially upholstered at the ends and also display ornate woodwork. The legs of the sofa are slender and curved, continuing the overall decorative style. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, making the sofa the focal point without any other objects present.
title: Sofa
